menu.name: Menu
menu.purpose: Expose compact contextual actions from a trigger without leaving the current task.

anatomy.rule: Floats near the trigger with compact surface treatment.
Presents one action with label, optional icon, and state.
Groups different categories or risk levels.

variants.description: Avatar trigger for account menus in topbar or identity surfaces.

Energy.decision: Use semantic surfaces and danger item color.
Energy.behavior: Items remain readable and risk is clear.

Frame.decision: Use compact item height, padding, gap, and separators.

Depth.decision: Use elevation for anchored floating surface.
Depth.behavior: Panel separates from table or toolbar.

Momentum.decision: Use scale and fade for open motion.

State.decision: Use open, focus, disabled, default, and closed states.

Tone.decision: Use tone for destructive item language.

Growth.decision: Escalate long or rich content to Drawer or Dialog.

Symbol.decision: Use symbols only to reinforce action meaning.

Iconography.decision: Use Design System icon size and alignment.

Accessibility.decision: Use menu semantics, expanded trigger, Escape, focus, and disabled behavior.
Accessibility.behavior: Keyboard users can open and close predictably.

dont: Do not place forms in Menu.
Do not hide primary actions only in Menu.
Do not use fake item controls.
info: Use Drawer for longer or richer content.

agentInstructions: Use Menu for compact contextual actions.
Ask before hiding primary or destructive actions.
Escalate forms or long lists to Drawer.

props.name: items
props.notes: Menu items, separators, icons, disabled states, danger tone, and optional shortcuts.

props.name: variant
props.notes: Action model shown by the menu.

props.name: avatarName
props.notes: Name rendered by Avatar when variant is avatar-trigger.

props.name: avatarStatus
props.notes: Avatar status rendered by the trigger when variant is avatar-trigger.

props.name: avatarSize
props.notes: Avatar size rendered by the trigger when variant is avatar-trigger.

props.name: density
props.notes: Controls trigger, panel, and item scale for sm, md, and lg contexts.

props.name: align
props.notes: Panel alignment relative to the trigger.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.notes: Called when local open state changes.

props.name: onSelect
props.notes: Called when an item is selected.
